newsitem.title: USA: Paracelsus and Pharmacia indicated lower.
newsitem.headline: Paracelsus and Pharmacia indicated lower.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Paracelsus Healthcare Corp was indicated at five to 6-1/2, down sharply from its previous closing price.

Shares in Paracelsus have not traded since Wednesday, when the company announced its third quarter earnings would fall well short of expectations and said it might have to restate previous results. Shares closed Wednesday at 10-1/8.

The NYSE said Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc was indicated at 36 to 38, down from their previous closing price of 41-3/8. London-listed shares in the company fell earlier today after Pharmacia warned of disappointing earnings.
